title: AI Structural Shifts on 2026-11-04: From Parametric Memory to Inference-Efficient Tooling and a China-Led Capital Surge
core_insight: AI is converging on self-contained, inference‑efficient models and deep integration into physical‑world engineering, while a historic China‑driven capital influx underscores a structural shift toward AI‑native tooling and parametric memory.

dimension_texts.technology: Recent papers such as AuroraWorld and MemU-Bench demonstrate extended long-horizon video generation and GUI interaction capabilities, while MEMENTO introduces long-context management for agents; together they expand model reliability and efficiency. Emerging paradigms include neuron-level hierarchical modeling ("Neurons Are All You Need"), agentic chemical informatics (DeepMind Antigravity), and parametric memory that internalizes retrieved knowledge, indicating a move beyond pure Transformers toward finer-grained or agentic structures. Neurons Are All You Need
